code_lines: SELECT T1.AÑO,T1.TRIM,T1.PERIODO,'S.14' AS C_SI_SCN,'B.6' AS C_SCN_N1,'Ingreso disponible bruto' AS N_SCN_N1,'YG' AS C_CUENTA,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='D' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) FORMAT COMMA14. AS DATO,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='D' THEN T1.ANTERIOR*-1 ELSE T1.ANTERIOR END) FORMAT COMMA14. AS ANTERIOR,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='D' THEN T1.NUEVA*-1 ELSE T1.NUEVA END) FORMAT COMMA14. AS NUEVA,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='D' THEN T1.DELTA*-1 ELSE T1.DELTA END) FORMAT COMMA14. AS DELTA,
PROC SQL;/*ID CORRIDO PARA CALCULAR VAR ANUAL*/
FROM YD_TRIM T1 WHERE T1.VERSION NOT IN ('DELTA');QUIT;
(T1.DATO/T2.DATO)*100-100 FORMAT COMMA14.2 AS DATO,(T1.ANTERIOR/T2.ANTERIOR)*100-100 FORMAT COMMA14.2  AS ANTERIOR,(T1.NUEVA/T2.NUEVA)*100-100 FORMAT COMMA14.2  AS NUEVA,T1.VERSION
FROM YD_TRIM T1,YD_MOD T2 WHERE T1.AÑO=T2.AÑO AND T1.TRIM=T2.TRIM AND T1.VERSION=T2.VERSION AND T1.VERSION NOT IN ('DELTA');QUIT;
PROC SQL; CREATE TABLE YD_VA_D AS /*CALCULA DELTA EN VAR ANUAL...BORRAR AÑO 2020 EN FILTRO*/
SELECT T1.AÑO,T1.TRIM,T1.PERIODO,T1.C_SI_SCN,T1.C_SCN_N1,T1.N_SCN_N1,T1.C_CUENTA, SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VERSION='ANTERIOR' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VERSION='ANTERIOR' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) FORMAT COMMA14.2 AS DELTA,'DELTA' AS VERSION
FROM YD_VA T1 WHERE AÑO<2020 GROUP BY T1.AÑO,T1.TRIM,T1.PERIODO,T1.C_SI_SCN,T1.C_SCN_N1,T1.N_SCN_N1,T1.C_CUENTA;QUIT;
proc sql; drop table YD_VA_D, YD_MOD;quit;
/*CREA GRÁFICO DE BARRAS PARA CAMBIOS en debe*/
SELECT PERIODO, DATO, C_CUENTA, C_ENTRADA, C_SCN_N1,N_SCN_N1
FROM V_DELTA_SC as T WHERE (T.C_CUENTA="&Cuenta" AND T.C_ENTRADA="D" AND ABS(DATO)<>0 AND SUBSTR(C_SCN_N1,1,2) NOT IN ('B.'));QUIT;
PATTERN1 COLOR=BIB;	PATTERN2 COLOR=BIBG;PATTERN3 COLOR=BIG;PATTERN4 COLOR=BIY;PATTERN5 COLOR=DARKGREEN;PATTERN6 COLOR=BURLYWOOD;PATTERN7 COLOR=BROWN;PATTERN8 COLOR=PURPLE;
PATTERN9 COLOR=BIPPK;PATTERN10 COLOR=DARKORANGE;PATTERN11 COLOR=SALMON;PATTERN12 COLOR=GRLG;PATTERN13 COLOR=GRPB;PATTERN14 COLOR=VILG;PATTERN15 COLOR=GOLD;
SYMBOL1 INTERPOL=JOIN HEIGHT=10pt VALUE=none LINE=1 WIDTH=2 CV = BLACK;
/*Legend2 CBORDER=WHITE POSITION = (MIDDLE RIGHT OUTSIDE) ACROSS=1 LABEL=(POSITION=(TOP)J=l "Instrumento");
/*Legend1 CBORDER=WHITE POSITION = (TOP RIGHT OUTSIDE)  MODE=reserve LABEL=("")*/;
BAR	 PERIODO / SUMVAR=DATO SUBGROUP=C_SCN_N1 FRAME TYPE=SUM COUTLINE=SAME RAXIS=AXIS1 RAXIS=AXIS1 MAXIS=AXIS2 LEGEND=LEGEND2;
/*CREA GRÁFICO DE BARRAS PARA CAMBIOS en debe total*/
proc sgplot  data=COMPARA_SC (where=(C_CUENTA="&Cuenta" AND C_ENTRADA="D" AND SUBSTR(C_SCN_N1,1,2) NOT IN ('B.')));
title "COMPARA SERIE: Cuenta:&Cuenta - Sector:&Sector - Total Activo/Gasto";
vline PERIODO / response=ANTERIOR LEGENDLABEL="Anterior" lineattrs=(color=black thickness=3);
vline PERIODO / response=NUEVA LEGENDLABEL="Nueva" lineattrs=(color=red thickness=2 pattern=20);
vbar PERIODO / response=DELTA  LEGENDLABEL="Delta" y2axis filltype=solid fillattrs=(color=silver) /*nooutline*/ barwidth=.7 transparency=0.5 baselineattrs=(thickness=.3) NOZEROBARS;
Y2AXIS LABEL="Delta" labelpos=top;yaxis LABEL="Nivel" labelpos=top; xaxis discreteorder=unformatted display=(nolabel) fitpolicy=rotatethin ;

FOOTNOTE "(*) Activo menos pasivo/Ingreso  menos gasto";
BAR	 PERIODO / SUMVAR=DATO SUBGROUP=C_SCN_N1 FRAME TYPE=SUM COUTLINE=SAME RAXIS=AXIS1 RAXIS=AXIS1 MAXIS=AXIS2 LEGEND=LEGEND2;
/*CREA GRÁFICO PARA CAMBIOS EN EL SALDO DE LA CUENTA (en cta fin y balances)*/
proc sgplot  data=COMPARA_SC (where=(C_CUENTA="&Cuenta" AND C_ENTRADA="H" AND C_SCN_N1 IN ('B.9','B.90','B.10')));
footnote "(*) Saldo de la cuenta corresponde  a  Excedente (Cta. Producción), Ahorro (Cta. YG),";
footnote2 "Capacidad/Necesidad  de fin. (Cta. Capital o Financiera) o Valor neto (Balance)";
vline PERIODO / response=ANTERIOR LEGENDLABEL="Anterior" lineattrs=(color=black thickness=3);
vline PERIODO / response=NUEVA LEGENDLABEL="Nueva" lineattrs=(color=red thickness=2 pattern=20);
vbar PERIODO / response=DELTA  LEGENDLABEL="Delta" y2axis filltype=solid fillattrs=(color=silver) /*nooutline*/ barwidth=.7 transparency=0.5 baselineattrs=(thickness=.3) NOZEROBARS;
Y2AXIS LABEL="Delta" labelpos=top;yaxis LABEL="Nivel" labelpos=top; xaxis discreteorder=unformatted display=(nolabel) fitpolicy=rotatethin ;
/*CREA GRÁFICO DE BARRAS PARA CAMBIOS NETO DEBE Y HABER CTA FIN Y BLCES, PORCENTAJE DEL PIB*/
SELECT PERIODO, SUM(CASE WHEN C_ENTRADA='H' THEN DATO*-1 ELSE DATO END) AS DATO, C_CUENTA, C_SCN_N1,N_SCN_N1

FROM COMPARA_SC_PIBF as T WHERE (T.C_CUENTA="&Cuenta" AND T.C_CUENTA IN ('Financiera','Bce Final','Rec Precio','Rec Volumen') AND ABS(DATO)<>0 AND  C_SCN_N1 NOT IN ('B.9','B.90','B.10') AND VERSION='DELTA') GROUP BY PERIODO,C_CUENTA,C_SCN_N1,N_SCN_N1;QUIT;
PATTERN1 COLOR=BIB;	PATTERN2 COLOR=BIBG;PATTERN3 COLOR=BIG;PATTERN4 COLOR=BIY;PATTERN5 COLOR=DARKGREEN;PATTERN6 COLOR=BURLYWOOD;PATTERN7 COLOR=BROWN;PATTERN8 COLOR=PURPLE;
PATTERN9 COLOR=BIPPK;PATTERN10 COLOR=DARKORANGE;PATTERN11 COLOR=SALMON;PATTERN12 COLOR=GRLG;PATTERN13 COLOR=GRPB;PATTERN14 COLOR=VILG;PATTERN15 COLOR=GOLD;
SYMBOL1 INTERPOL=JOIN HEIGHT=10pt VALUE=none LINE=1 WIDTH=2 CV = BLACK;
/*Legend2 CBORDER=WHITE POSITION = (MIDDLE RIGHT OUTSIDE) ACROSS=1 LABEL=(POSITION=(TOP)J=l "Instrumento");
/*Legend1 CBORDER=WHITE POSITION = (TOP RIGHT OUTSIDE)  MODE=reserve LABEL=("")*/;
FOOTNOTE "(*) Activo menos pasivo/Ingreso  menos gasto";
BAR	 PERIODO / SUMVAR=DATO SUBGROUP=C_SCN_N1 FRAME TYPE=SUM COUTLINE=SAME RAXIS=AXIS1 RAXIS=AXIS1 MAXIS=AXIS2 LEGEND=LEGEND2;
/*CREA GRÁFICO PARA CAMBIOS EN EL SALDO DE LA CUENTA EN TERMINOS DEL PIB (en cta fin y balances)*/
proc sgplot  data=COMPARA_SC_PIBF (where=(C_CUENTA="&Cuenta" AND C_ENTRADA="H" AND C_SCN_N1 IN ('B.9','B.90','B.10')));
footnote "(*) Saldo de la cuenta corresponde  a  Excedente (Cta. Producción), Ahorro (Cta. YG),";
footnote2 "Capacidad/Necesidad  de fin. (Cta. Capital o Financiera) o Valor neto (Balance)";
vline PERIODO / response=ANTERIOR LEGENDLABEL="Anterior" lineattrs=(color=black thickness=3);
vline PERIODO / response=NUEVA LEGENDLABEL="Nueva" lineattrs=(color=red thickness=2 pattern=20);
vbar PERIODO / response=DELTA  LEGENDLABEL="Delta" y2axis filltype=solid fillattrs=(color=silver) /*nooutline*/ barwidth=.7 transparency=0.5 baselineattrs=(thickness=.3) NOZEROBARS;
Y2AXIS LABEL="Delta" labelpos=top;yaxis LABEL="Nivel" labelpos=top; xaxis discreteorder=unformatted display=(nolabel) fitpolicy=rotatethin ;
